name: Bungala One Solar Farm
current_developer: Bungala One Operations Pty Ltd as trustee for the Bungala One Operations Trust
notable: 95 MW solar farm near Port Augusta, SA. Stage 1 of the 190 MW Bungala Solar Power Project. Developed by ENEL Green Power / DIF Capital Partners. One of the first utility-scale solar projects in the Port Augusta renewable energy precinct.

timeline.title: Commercial operations commenced
timeline.detail: Commencement date from AEMO registration via OpenElectricity.

timeline.title: First generation recorded
timeline.detail: First market dispatch data recorded in AEMO systems.

eis_specs.document_title: Bungala Solar Project Stage 1 – Development Application to SA Development Assessment Commission (Reach Solar Energy, September 2016)
eis_specs.connection_substation_name: Davenport substation (via 33 kV collector switchyard + new 33/132 kV project step-up substation)
eis_specs.connection_distance_note: New 132 kV overhead line from onsite 33/132 kV substation to ElectraNet's Davenport substation near Port Augusta
eis_specs.connection_augmentation: New 132 kV OH line and 33/132 kV project step-up substation designed and built by ElectraNet
eis_specs.notes: Stage 1 of the 275 MWac Bungala Solar Project (Bungala 1 + Bungala 2). 137.7 MW DC / 110 MW AC. Panels: Jinko Solar polycrystalline (~840,000 modules combined across both stages). Inverters: SMA. Tracker: NEXTracker single-axis (1.5 m axis height, 5.5 m spacing). Originally developed by Reach Solar Energy; DA lodged Sep 2016 to SA Development Assessment Commission. Now owned by Enel Green Power + DIF Infrastructure JV (Potentia Energy operates). Commissioned September 2018; Origin Energy PPA for full output. NO planning-report PDF publicly indexed — plan.sa.gov.au register only.
